name: reepolee
description: Long-lived Apps without deps and build on Bun

scripts.service:install: sudo journalctl --rotate -u reepolee && sudo journalctl --vacuum-time=1s -u reepolee && sudo cp ./operations/reepolee.service /etc/systemd/system/reepolee.service
scripts.service:remove: sudo systemctl stop reepolee && sudo systemctl disable reepolee && sudo rm /etc/systemd/system/reepolee.service && sudo systemctl daemon-reload
scripts.get:zod: mkdir -p vendor && curl -fsSL https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/zod@4.4.3/+esm -o vendor/zod.min.js && curl -fsSL https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/zod@4.4.3/LICENSE -o vendor/zod.min.js.LICENSE.txt
scripts.get:hljs: mkdir -p vendor && curl -fsSL https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/highlight.js@11.11.1/+esm -o vendor/highlight.min.js && curl -fsSL https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/highlight.js@11.11.1/LICENSE -o vendor/highlight.min.js.LICENSE.txt
scripts.get:xlsx: mkdir -p vendor && curl -fsSL https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/xlsx@0.18.5/dist/xlsx.full.min.js -o vendor/xlsx.full.min.js && curl -fsSL https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/xlsx@0.18.5/LICENSE -o vendor/xlsx.full.min.js.LICENSE.txt
scripts.get:temporal: mkdir -p vendor && curl -fsSL https://esm.sh/@js-temporal/polyfill@0.5.1/es2022/polyfill.bundle.mjs -o vendor/temporal.min.js && curl -fsSL https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@js-temporal/polyfill@0.5.1/LICENSE -o vendor/temporal.min.js.LICENSE.txt
scripts.get:dpu: mkdir -p static && curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoogleChromeLabs/html-setters-polyfill/main/index.min.js -o static/dpu.min.js && curl -fsSL https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/html-setters-polyfill/LICENSE -o static/dpu.min.js.LICENSE.txt
scripts.add:user:alice: bun generator/user alice alice@example.com a --modules system,user,reeman
scripts.add:user:bob: bun generator/user bob bob@example.com b --modules user
